sentences.text:
X (Juvenile) vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 6 February, 2025
Author: Samit Gopal
Bench: Samit Gopal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 78
Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 2237 of 2023
Revisionist :- X (Juvenile)
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Revisionist :- Alok Tiwari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Abhishek Pandey,G.A.,Jitendra Nath Pandey
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: No one appears on behalf of the revisionist to press the prayer for bail in the present revision.
Sri Abhishek Pandey and Sri Jitendra Nath Pandey, learned counsels for the private respondents are also not present even when the matter has been taken up in the revised list.
Sri Bade Lal Bind, learned counsel for the State is present.
2. The present revision has been filed by the revisionist against the judgement and order dated 11.07.2022 passed by Special Judge (POCSO Act) /Addl.

District and Sessions Judge, Pilibhit in Criminal Appeal no.14 of 2022 whereby the appeal preferred on behalf of the revisionist has been dismissed against the order dated 24.5.2022 passed by Principal Magistrate, Juvenile Justice Board,
Pilibhit in Case No.03 of 2021 arising out of Case Crime No.397 of 2021, u/s 302, 376, 201 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, P.S. Barkheda, District Pilibhit whereby the bail application of the revisionist has been rejected and further to grant the custody of the revisionist to his father after releasing him on X (Juvenile) vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111127593/
1 bail.

sentences.text: 3. Since there is no representation on behalf of the revisionist despite the matter being taken up in the revised list, the prayer for bail in the present revision is dismissed for want of prosecution.
4. The present revision is consigned to records.

(Samit Gopal, J.) Order Date :- 6.2.2025 Gaurav Kuls  X (Juvenile) vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111127593/
